symptom.name: Machine home position is lost
symptom.description: The machine home position is lost after an absolute encoder alarm.

failure_modes.name: Battery for the absolute encoder goes dead
failure_modes.description: The absolute encoder battery is dead or the encoder is disconnected, losing position tracking.

corrective_actions.name: Reference the axis
corrective_actions.description: Reset the home position and reference the axis: set parameter 1815 APZ bit to 0, power down, jog the axis to the alignment marks, set the APZ bit to 1 and power down again.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Reset the home position and reference the axis: set parameter 1815 APZ bit to 0, power down, jog the axis to the alignment marks, set the APZ bit to 1 and power down again.
corrective_actions.source_title: Fryer VB Series FANUC 0i-MF CNC Maintenance Manual

symptom.name: Loss of motion in the axis
symptom.description: Measured backlash shows loss of motion in the axis.

failure_modes.name: Backlash in ballscrew and linear guide rails
failure_modes.description: Backlash from the ballscrew and linear guide rails is out of specification.

corrective_actions.name: Adjust backlash compensation
corrective_actions.description: Adjust backlash compensation according to the procedure in Section 3.33.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Adjust backlash compensation according to the procedure in Section 3.33.
corrective_actions.source_title: Fryer VB Series FANUC 0i-MF CNC Maintenance Manual
